div.p: claude.ai (web and mobile) connects through OAuth, so no bearer key is needed.

ol.li: Open claude.ai and go to Settings, Connectors.
Click "Add custom connector" and paste the MCP URL shown above.
Log in to Odoo and authorize the requested access.

div.p: The connection runs as your Odoo user and can be revoked anytime from your user preferences (Account Security, OAuth Connections).
